stem_book: A uniform rod AB of mass 2 kg and length l = 100 cm is placed on a sharp support O such that AO = a = 40 cm and OB = b = 60 cm. A spring of force constant k = 600 N/m is attached to end B and to the floor below, as shown in figure. To keep the rod horizontal, its end A is tied with a thread (to the floor) such that the spring is elongated by y = 1 cm. Calculate the reaction of the support on the rod just after the thread is burnt. (g = 10 m/s²)
reason: added g = 10 and 'just after' (the reaction changes as the rod turns)
